summary: This directory contains documentation and visual demonstrations for Material UI-based form components. It provides isolated examples of various input types and form configurations to verify component behavior, styling, and integration with validation logic within the UI adapter layer.
responsibilities: Provide visual documentation for form components
Demonstrate integration between forms and UI input fields
Showcase component states including validation and interactivity
Test custom rendering capabilities for form fields
relationships: Component stories serve as documentation for different input field types and form structures.
The AutoForm stories demonstrate how the form container manages various field types and validation states.
designDecisions: Use of story-based documentation for isolated component testing
Categorization by primary UI component type
